title: Authentic Charred Scottish Sausage Skewers
description: A traditional Scottish dish featuring charred sausages served with applesauce, grilled to perfection on a robata grill in a copper pot, suitable for a Buddhist temple gathering

ingredients.name: Scottish sausage
ingredients.notes: preferably made with beef and pork

instructions: Preheat the robata grill to medium-high heat, approximately 400 degrees Fahrenheit, in a copper pot.
Thread the Scottish sausage, onion, bell pepper, and mushroom onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and season with salt and black pepper.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the sausage is charred and cooked through.
Serve the skewers hot with applesauce on the side.
Garnish with fresh parsley or rosemary, if desired.
Ensure the skewers are cooked to an internal temperature of at least 160 degrees Fahrenheit to ensure food safety.
